teams.name: Aimpunch
teams.notes: xmeijixx switch to baililmao, yuuki_ps switched to chiai
teams.bio: The most decorated organization in Bot Pro League history, Aimpunch are Singapore's benchmark team — a dynasty forged across 2022 and 2023 that peaked with the 2023 BPL Conquerors Major. Led by in-game leader Chiai Fujikawa and headlined by Sketch, they have turned sustained excellence into a trophy haul no rival can match.

roster.name: Chiai Fujikawa
roster.bio: The voice behind Aimpunch's championship run, Chiai Fujikawa is a Malaysian in-game leader who calls the shots for one of BPL's most successful teams. A four-time champion — headlined by the 2023 BPL Conquerors Major — he pairs a tactical mind with real firepower, carrying a Level 6 1334 points and a 1.13 K/D that few IGLs can match.

roster.name: Sketch
roster.bio: One of the most decorated names in BPL history, Sketch is a Singaporean rifler who has been a constant through Aimpunch's championship era. His six trophies span the club's entire run — from the 2020 opener at BPL Tournament Minor 1 to the 2023 BPL Conquerors Major — and few players can match that longevity at the top. A steady, no-frills fragger, he has always let his consistency do the talking.

roster.name: balililmao
roster.bio: balililmao is a Singaporean rifler and a four-time BPL champion with Aimpunch, a dependable presence across the club's 2022–2023 title haul. Steady rather than spectacular, she has been a trusted piece of the rotation through some of the league's biggest matches, including the 2023 Conquerors Major.

roster.name: [Idiot] AngelCrutcher
roster.bio: AngelCrutcher is the utility man of Aimpunch's dynasty, a Singaporean flex player who has slotted into whatever role the roster demanded across six title runs. His numbers rarely top the scoreboard, but his willingness to play the thankless positions was a quiet cornerstone of one of the league's great teams.

roster.name: mond33__
roster.bio: mond33__ has held the AWP for Aimpunch through all six of the club's championships, a Singaporean sniper whose composure on the big rounds helped define their dynasty. Her raw rating sits modestly, but a résumé that includes the 2023 BPL Conquerors Major speaks to a player who delivers when the trophies are on the line.

teams.name: Infernum E-Sports
